education_expenditure_pivot = education_expenditure_data.pivot(index='Country Code', columns='Series Code', values=[col for col in df.columns if col.startswith('19') or col.startswith('20')])
gdp_pivot = gdp_data.pivot(index='Country Code', columns='Series Code', values=[col for col in df.columns if col.startswith('19') or col.startswith('20')])

# Drop the 'Series Code' column
education_expenditure_pivot = education_expenditure_pivot.drop(columns='Series Code')
gdp_pivot = gdp_pivot.drop(columns='Series Code')

# Rename the columns for clarity
education_expenditure_pivot.columns = education_expenditure_pivot.columns.droplevel(0)
gdp_pivot.columns = gdp_pivot.columns.droplevel(0)

# Merge the data on 'Country Code'
merged_data = pd.merge(education_expenditure_pivot, gdp_pivot, on='Country Code')

merged_data.head()
